goal: Prevent infinite loops and 100% CPU hangs when reading corrupted legacy Berkeley DB wallets
Ensure wallet migration and dumping fail cleanly instead of blocking RPC workers or node shutdown
reviewability: Nothing known that would invalidate a review now

categories.name: wallet
why: P3 because it fixes an infinite loop during migration and wallet dumping on corrupted BDB files
Malformed files can peg a worker thread at 100% CPU and block shutdown, but corrupted wallets are rare
